starting_known_facts: Mara Holt is present at the start and can explain the immediate situation.
Mara Holt should be useful without taking choices away from the player.
Mara Holt has a clear stake in the first objective.
Mara Holt can recur if the player keeps involving them.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Dust rattles against the east barricade.

Mara Holt marks a stalled convoy on the road map and hands you a filter mask.

(Mara Holt) "Medicine crate is still out there. We bring it back, or we start choosing who gets worse."
